# kc.toml required

A repository directory must contain a kc.toml file; otherwise compilation aborts with a CompileError (user must run `kc init`).

Ensure repository-level configuration exists before any compile run so the runner knows repository metadata and settings.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run.read_config`
